integrity: The infinite claim is justified by the written analytic argument; the exact-rational finite checker supplies corroboration only. No external review, independent audit, or priority certification has been performed.
limitations: Does not address unequal Poisson component rates, nonuniform jump laws, or a classification of global modes. Earlier or separately titled equivalent work cannot be categorically excluded.
scientific_scope: For every integer \(k\ge2\), for independent common-rate \(\operatorname{Poisson}(\lambda)\) counts, the complete strict tail-decrease criterion is \(0<\lambda<\lambda_k^\star\), where \(S_k(\lambda_k^\star)=1\).
title: Sharp decreasing-tail threshold for every Poisson distribution of order \(k\)
